---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Ethan Katz"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(births_by_date, aes(x = month, y = date_of_month, fill = average_births)) +
  geom_tile()
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(24, 25, 26)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    weekday = first(day_of_week[date_of_month == 25]),
    christmas_births = mean(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(24, 26)]),
    pct_of_baseline = 100 * christmas_births / baseline_births,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = weekday))
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
calendar_resid <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(percent_residual = 100 * (births - predict(births_model)) / births) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarize(calendar_resid = mean(percent_residual), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- tibble(
  month = c(1, 7, 11, 12),
  date_of_month = c(1, 4, 27, 25),
  holiday = c("New Year's Day", "July 4", "Thanksgiving", "Christmas")
)

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = month, y = date_of_month, fill = calendar_resid)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_point(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = month, y = date_of_month),
    color = "white",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = month, y = date_of_month, label = holiday),
    color = "white",
    size = 3,
    nudge_y = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
```
